teaching.title: Peer Programming Mentor
bullets: Supported beginner programming practice sessions covering lists and dictionaries, with debugging as an additional topic.
Explained worked examples on lists, dictionaries, and debugging under a course instructor's supervision.

projects.title: Command-Line Word Game

Tested example inputs and documented the program's behaviour, using Git as a project tool.
